from datetime import date
import pytest
from late_fee import LateFeeCalculator as C

DUE = date(2024, 1, 1)  # Mon

@pytest.mark.parametrize("bal,today,exp", [
    (0, date(2024, 6, 1), 0),               # zero balance
    (-1, date(2024, 6, 1), 0),              # negative
    (10_000, date(2023, 12, 1), 0),         # today before due
    (10_000, date(2024, 1, 13), 0),         # Sat; 10 weekdays = grace
    (10_000, date(2024, 1, 15), 0),         # weekend skipped, still 10
    (10_000, date(2024, 1, 16), 500),       # 1 billable day -> min fee
    (10_000_000, date(2024, 1, 16), 5000),  # 1 day, above min
    (1_000_000, date(2026, 1, 1), 250_000), # 25% cap
])
def test_fee(bal, today, exp):
    assert C(today).compute_fee_cents(bal, DUE) == exp

def test_default_today():
    assert C()._today == date.today()
